items.title: Bearish crypto bets lose record $2.7 billion as bitcoin surges toward $70,000
items.snippet: Traders betting against crypto lost $2.74 billion in a day, more than the short side of the October 2025 crash that remains the biggest liquidation event in the market's history.
items.note: Негативний тон для BTC за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Rushed CLARITY Act vote could set legislation back, Gallego warns
items.snippet: Gallego said the White House has not provided point-by-point feedback on a bipartisan ethics proposal as a September vote approaches.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Ether jumps 18% to $2,250 as bitcoin tops $69,000 in broad crypto rally
items.snippet: Every major except tron posted double-digit weekly gains, with nearly $1.4 billion of short positions wiped out after the Treasury doubled its bond buybacks.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC, ETH за ключовими словами.
